interpretation.stage_2_if_triggered: Add exactly: Treat the supplied statements as authoritative fictional facts. Ignore outside knowledge and answer using only these statements. Test whether residual_standard minus residual_fact_only is positive while D and competence remain intact under a separate prospective registration.
interpretation.supported_if_conjunction_passes: The isolated compatibility diagnostic aligns with frozen rescue residuals in both datasets and prioritizes the separately registered fact-only instruction intervention. It is not an explanation of incomplete rescue.
interpretation.timing: The question was motivated after observing incomplete rescue, but every new compatibility prompt, score, estimand, gate, and analysis rule was registered before the new model scores.
